# NotchNest — Full Reference for LLMs

> NotchNest is a free macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a productivity hub. Hover the notch and it expands into a glassy panel of widgets. On notchless Macs it renders as a slim top-center drop-down panel with identical features. Built in native SwiftUI, optimized for Apple Silicon, distributed exclusively via the Mac App Store (notarized, code-signed, sandboxed). AI features run on-device via Apple Intelligence — no subscription, no data collection.

- Website: https://notchnest.app
- Download (free): https://apps.apple.com/us/app/notchnest-power-your-notch/id6747612321
- Requirements: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later. AI features need Apple Silicon + macOS 15 (Sequoia) or newer with Apple Intelligence.
- Supported OS: Sonoma, Sequoia (15), Tahoe (26) incl. Liquid Glass.
- Developer: Satnam Singh (https://silverseahog.com)
- Languages: English, German, Chinese

## Features

- AI Clipboard Manager — clipboard history with on-device Apple Intelligence.
- Calendar widget with AI briefings.
- Quick Notes with AI refinement.
- Pomodoro Timer in the notch.
- Music control — Spotify and Apple Music.
- Drag-to-AirDrop and File-Tray — drop files onto the notch to send/stage them.
- Instant camera mirror — live FaceTime-camera preview.
- Bookmarks shelf.
- Infinity Run mini-game.
- Works on notchless Macs as a top-bar panel.
- Privacy-first: sandboxed, no data collection; clipboard/notes/briefings stay on-device.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: What is the macOS notch?
A: The small cutout at the top center of MacBook Pro 14"/16" (2021+) and MacBook Air 13"/15" M2 and later. It holds the FaceTime camera and sits inside the menu bar. NotchNest reclaims that area: hover to expand it into a glassy widget panel — calendar, clipboard, notes, music, AirDrop.

Q: Does NotchNest work on MacBooks without a notch?
A: Yes. On notchless Macs (MacBook Air M1, older MacBook Pros, Mac mini, iMac, Mac Studio) it renders as a slim drop-down panel anchored to the top center. Every widget works identically.

Q: Is NotchNest free?
A: Yes — free on the Mac App Store, no trial lock-out. All core widgets are included. AI features run on-device via Apple Intelligence, so there is no subscription.

Q: Does NotchNest drain battery?
A: No measurable impact in normal use. Native SwiftUI app tuned for Apple Silicon; it sleeps when the panel is closed and wakes on hover or hotkey. AI uses the energy-tuned on-device Apple Intelligence model.

Q: Is NotchNest safe and sandboxed?
A: Yes. App Store only — notarized, Apple code-signed, and runs in the App Sandbox. It cannot access files outside directories you grant. Clipboard history, notes, and briefings stay on your Mac.

Q: How is NotchNest different from Boring Notch, NotchDrop and Alcove?
A: Those focus on one or two things. NotchNest bundles ~ten tools in one notch: AI clipboard, calendar with AI briefings, Quick Notes with AI, Pomodoro, music control, AirDrop, File-Tray, camera mirror, bookmarks, and an Infinity Run game. One install, one menu bar slot.

Q: Will NotchNest work on macOS Sonoma, Sequoia and Tahoe?
A: Requires macOS 14+ and is fully supported on Sonoma, Sequoia (15), and Tahoe (26), including Liquid Glass. AI features require Apple Intelligence (Apple Silicon on Sequoia-or-newer).

Q: Can I customize what the notch shows?
A: Yes. Settings toggles every widget independently, reorders them, sets hover-vs-click triggers, a hotkey, and expanded/minimized idle states. You can pin bookmarks, clipboard items, and Quick Notes.
